title: Tuesday afternoon legs
subtitle: ~32 min · at home · 15 lb dumbbells + mat
feeling: Simple and steady: one round of 6 moves, repeat it. Short cues, no thinking.
note: Keep water close and sip between rounds. If you feel dizzy at all, stop and sit down. 2 rounds is still a great workout. No jumping needed today.

items.name: Leg swings
items.cue: Hold a wall, 10 each leg. Gentle.

sections.label: 2 · The circuit · 3-4 rounds · ~20 min
sections.instructions: Do the 6 moves in order, rest 1 min, repeat. Aim for 3, add a 4th if you feel good. Tap a move after your last round.

items.name: Reverse lunge
items.cue: Step back, push through the front heel.

items.name: Romanian deadlift
items.cue: Slow, hips back, stop at a light stretch.

items.name: Fast march
items.cue: Knees high, pump your arms. Then rest 1 min.

items.name: Side plank on your hand
items.cue: Drop the bottom knee if needed.

items.name: Bird dog
items.cue: Opposite arm and leg, hips level.

items.name: Hamstring, hip and quad stretch
items.cue: 30 sec per stretch, per side. Breathe.
